name: Weather Widget Overlay UI

intent.description: simple weather-app-style overlay for showing day-of-run weather and temperature context
avoid: decorative background art behind the widgets

cardTemplate.label: Simple Card
cardTemplate.notes: only template; blue translucent card with vertical divider, compact left visual block, and location/country slot. Alternative presentations ship as separate components.

rules: all icons use the same family and optical weight
rounded filled geometric shapes are preferred
icons must scale cleanly to 20, 32, 48, and 64 px
do not mix emoji, realistic, outline-only, and cartoon treatments

phase2: Open-Meteo historical API by activity timestamp
OpenWeather One Call 4.0 one-hour timeline by activity timestamp when an API key is configured
activity-location fetch by first FIT GPS route point

inspectorSectionSeparatorRule: Collapsed Weather Widget section headers draw one bottom separator only so adjacent boundaries stay a single thin line.

inspectorSectionsHiddenForV1.reason: Shared overlay background controls do not affect the Weather Widget SwiftUI card renderer.
Shared overlay border controls do not affect the Weather Widget SwiftUI card renderer.

inspectorControlsImplemented: manual humidity, high/low, wind, feels-like fields for selected slots outside API modes
typography rows for location, condition, temperature, slot title, and slot label text

inspectorControlsHiddenForV1.reason: Card surface color is palette-owned in Weather Widget 1.0; the old field did not reliably affect the card renderer.
Icon size is template-owned in Weather Widget 1.0.

inspectorControlsHiddenForV1.control: manual API-owned text inputs in API modes
inspectorControlsHiddenForV1.reason: When the widget uses API data, condition, temperature, and metric values come from cached weather payloads.
OpenWeather requires an API key configured in Project Settings.

metricSlots.noneBehavior: selected '-' slots render no metric content
metricSlots.inlineFeelsLikeLabel: The inline metric row renders feelsLike as 'Feels 12°C'.

dividers.hiddenBehavior: when disabled, the divider line is not rendered; color, width, and opacity values are preserved but hidden from the Inspector

implementationNotes: weather widget is a dedicated overlay type with a single card template; alternative presentations ship as separate components
preview and export must share the same render layout
API-backed weather must be cached before export
fetch actions write cachedWeather, preserve the selected API dataSource, and update locationText from reverse geocoding
Open-Meteo archive request uses temperature_2m, relative_humidity_2m, apparent_temperature, weather_code, and wind_speed_10m
OpenWeather One Call 4.0 one-hour timeline request uses lat, lon, start, cnt=1, appid, and units=metric
OpenWeather HTTP 401 explains that a new key or subscription may still be activating, the One Call 4.0 subscription, the first 1,000 free calls per day, and the Open-Meteo fallback
SwiftUI preview/export uses the shared bundled PNG weather icon family
Core Graphics direct weather rendering is no longer a target for parity
